$comment: Nissan Silvia S15 with a GM LS1 (Gen III, 24x, cable throttle) or LS3 (Gen IV, 58x, drive-by-wire). Researched 2026-09-29 for Swap Lab Phase 1 part 3b. Sources are vendor listings and install guides (Sikky, Wiring Specialties, Chase Bays, Collins Performance Technologies, ISR, KE Conversions) plus two magazines; no Nissan or GM document covers this swap, so nearly everything is single-source. Prices are as listed on 2026-09-29, before options, in the listed currency. Generic LS hardware (ECUs, standalone harnesses, T56/TR6060, clutches, generic pans, CD009 adapters) is researched separately and only named here where a kit requires it. Not found: an S15-specific install guide, a Nissan parts catalogue entry for the front suspension member, a factory GM oil pan stated to clear the S15, any Japanese vendor, and any adapter for the S15's own gearboxes. Merged 2026-09-29 with the hardware common to every LS swap (GM PCM, Chevrolet Performance and Holley ECU routes, standalone harnesses, GM and Tremec gearboxes, clutches, fuel regulators), which a separate research pass sourced; those parts repeat in each LS swap file until Phase 3 moves them into parts/.
appliesTo: Every S15 (1999-2002, JDM Silvia and Australian 200SX; all RHD). The kits replace the S15 gearbox (FS6R92A, FS5W71C or RE4R01A) with a GM T56, T56 Magnum or TR6060, or a Nissan CD009-family gearbox; none keeps the factory gearbox. Parts for the LHD US 240SX (S13/S14) are a different fit and are not listed.
